name: Split Bone Necklace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Now that you have gathered Bloodscalp trophies, I have another task for you.  The Skullsplitter tribe of trolls live to the southeast, and for years we have warred with them.  Although the Darkspears no longer dwell in Stranglethorn, we are bound to our conflict with the Skullsplitters.

So, hunt them.  Gather their Split Bone Necklaces and return to me.  Aid us in our war, and you will earn the friendship of the Darkspears.
narrative.objectives: Bring 25 Split Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Your strength is great to have gained these necklaces, adventurer. The Skullsplitters fall to you like young saplings stomped to earth by a Basilisk!

Your deeds are a boon to us.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Skullsplitters will curse the day they brought us to war! Is your task complete?
